pages.title: The gathered result
pages.text: $(o)"A result shared by many hands must still answer to the weight of each hand."$()$(br2)The Gatherers Of Means described a weighted agreement: a result formed from several witnesses, each contributing according to a declared measure.

pages.title: A conjecture
pages.text: The note remains a conjecture. MathMod has no general weighted distribution rune yet, so this record grants no construction and cannot be cast as a spell.$(br2)Its next proof requires bounded collections, explicit weights, and a cost that grows with the number of witnesses.
